name: Button
summary: The only clickable action. Variants: primary (accent, max one per view), secondary (ink outline, the default), ghost (tertiary), danger (destructive).
do: Put the primary action last (rightmost) in a button group
dont: Two primary buttons on one screen
A raw <button> or a styled <a> pretending to be a button

name: Card
summary: A bordered group of related content with an optional title and header action. Flat, 1px line border, 24px padding.
do: Use for distinct groups (a settings section, a chart)

name: Field
summary: Labelled text input with hint and error text. Label above, 48px tall, accent focus ring.
props: label: string; hint?: string; error?: string; + input attributes
do: Show errors under the field, in brick

name: Badge
summary: Outlined pill for status. Tones: neutral, positive (moss), warning (ochre), negative (brick), accent.
do: One or two words, sentence case

name: StatTile
summary: A key number with label, delta and caption. Ink rule on top, Fraunces numeral, mono delta.
props: label: string; value: string; delta?: {value, direction:'up'|'down'}; caption?: string
do: Group 3-4 in a row with gap-8
Let the number be the biggest thing

name: DataTable
summary: Compact table: ink top/bottom rule, paper-2 header, hairline rows, mono numerals right-aligned. Scrolls horizontally inside its own container.
props: columns: Column<T>[] where Column<T> = { key: keyof T & string; header: string; align?: 'left' | 'right'; numeric?: boolean; render?: (row: T) => ReactNode } (render receives the WHOLE ROW, not the cell value); rows: T[] (the prop is `rows`, not `data`; every row needs a string `id`)

name: PageHeader
summary: Top of every page: optional mono eyebrow, Fraunces h1, description, actions on the right. Owns the page's only h1.
props: eyebrow?: string; title: string; description?: string; actions?: ReactNode
do: Put the page's primary Button here
dont: A second h1 elsewhere on the page

name: EmptyState
summary: Centred, dashed-border placeholder for empty lists with title, one sentence and one action.
props: title: string; body: string; action?: ReactNode
do: Say what will appear here and how to create it

name: SideNav
summary: App sidebar on paper-2 with product name and links; active item marked with an accent left rule.
props: product: string; items: {label, href, active?, count?}[]
do: Collapse to a top bar below md
